title: Meaningless is better: hashing bias-inducing words in LLM prompts improves performance in logical reasoning and statistical learning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM outputs on logical reasoning tasks using variations of the 'Linda problem' to measure the conjunction fallacy, and on statistical learning tasks using a frequent itemset extraction task with counterintuitive data to measure the representativeness heuristic. The paper compares performance across free-text, tabular, and hashed (masked) prompt formats.
